verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe's synchronous transcribe API documents a `word_time_offsets` boolean that includes word-level timestamps, and the API reference lists word-timestamp controls alongside timing fields in the JSON response. This directly delivers per-word mapping to recording position. missing for 10: documented per-word response schema (start/end offset fields and units), confirmation that word timestamps are available in live and batch modes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get word-level timestamps so every word maps to its position in the recording

citations.quote: word_time_offsets | boolean | false | Include word-level timestamps.
Its JSON response includes transcript segments, speaker or channel labels, and timing fields.
